tasks.label: Build (make all)
tasks.detail: STM32CubeIDE's own Debug build (Debug/makefile). NOTE the explicit 'all': a bare 'make' resolves to clean. 'No rule to make target ...' after source files were added or removed = run 'CubeIDE: regenerate Debug/ and build' once.

tasks.label: CubeIDE: regenerate Debug/ and build
tasks.detail: Headless STM32CubeIDE build in its own workspace (does not touch the one your CubeIDE has open). Rewrites Debug/makefile and subdir.mk, so new or deleted Core/Src files are picked up; ~30 s, ~4 min the first time.

tasks.label: Flash (ST-LINK)
tasks.detail: Builds the CubeIDE Debug image (default flags, DIAG label IDE), then flashes Debug/Dash.elf with STM32CubeProgrammer.

tasks.label: Build image variant (tools/build.py)
tasks.detail: Same compiler and flags as the Debug build, plus a -D variant; ROAD goes to build/, a variant to build-<name>/. DIAG shows the commit and the variant.

tasks.label: Build + flash image variant (tools/build.py)
tasks.detail: The only way to put a -D variant on the board (e.g. BACKLIGHT_ACTIVE_LOW=0 for the 2N7000 backlight driver): CubeIDE always builds the default.

tasks.label: Lint (-O2 warnings) + build
tasks.detail: Compiles Core/Src once more at -O2 with array-bounds / overflow warnings (the -O0 Debug build cannot see an index past an array's end), then builds build/Dash.elf.

tasks.label: Host tests
tasks.detail: tests/host on the PC (gcc/clang, or: pip install ziglang).

options.label: ROAD: default, current breadboard (Si4599 gate driven straight from PA8)
ROAD INV: carrier board with the 2N7000 backlight driver
BENCH DEMO: synthetic values, no car
BENCH FT1: loop hang -> watchdog reset
BENCH FT3: main-panel SPI errors (recovery, no reset)
BENCH KOEO: oil-pressure $2C/$AA experiment, parked only
LOOK FLIP: main panel turned 180 degrees (module mounted upside down)
LOOK PAL0: previous colour palette, to compare with the TN one
PROBE: which controller the main panel has (3 colour bands for 4 s at start)
